summary: Keep WhatsApp reconnecting with bounded slow backoff after prolonged transport failures.
reason: A transient DNS failure exhausted twelve attempts and was misclassified as terminal, disabling automatic recovery after network restoration.

tests.name: whatsapp-network-recovery
tests.evidence: 11 behavior cases and 7 patcher cases on real installed S24 code, with fake clocks and sockets; no live send.

tests.name: runtime-supervision-regression
tests.evidence: 10 runtime-sync, 9 gateway preflight, 5 stale-lock, 2 deploy-lock, channel-health and owner-send contracts passed.

tests.name: syntax
tests.evidence: All three patched modules parsed; modified shell scripts pass bash -n; git diff --check passed.

capabilities.reason: Transport recovery only; no business capability, MCP route, user permission or payment change.

architecture.reason: Existing WhatsApp connection controller and gateway health supervisor retain ownership; no new scheduler, store, daemon or retry engine.

rollback: Use the versioned patcher --rollback to restore verified original bytes, then restart through the Companion owner. Deployment rollback invokes it before reverting to a revision without the patch.
limitations: Not deployed; live extended outage and new inbound-to-delivered acceptance pending.
